responsibility: This generator builds insn_extract, the operand-extraction routine that maps recognized insns back into recog_data operand and dup locations. It analyzes each DEFINE_INSN pattern to discover structural paths to match_operand and match_dup occurrences, interns identical extraction schemes across insn codes, handles old-style peephole operand vectors specially, and emits the switch-based code that the recognizer and later passes use to recover operand rtx pointers and duplication sites from an insn’s RTL pattern.
